title: RHI Submission Rework Proposal

author_intent: 简洁实现，不做过度包装，不把所有阶段揉进一个大 Executor。
解耦实现，明确拆开 preprocess、translate、assemble submit、submission runtime、interrupt runtime。
submitinfo 只服务 submission thread，不承担 translate 过程的中间语义。
wait/signal 的具体 timeline value 延迟到 submission thread 解析，不在 preprocess 中提前固化。
CopyScope 和跨队列依赖以 submitinfo 粒度表达同步，而不是在 preprocess 中提前决定物理 wait/signal。
current_problem_summary: 当前 VulkanSubmissionExecutor.cpp 同时承担 preprocess、segment split、translate、submit、present、completion、interrupt 等多种职责。
当前 wait/signal 推导过早发生在 preprocess 中，导致逻辑依赖与物理 timeline value 耦合。
当前内部平台执行单元偏向 segment/PlatformExecOp，无法清晰表达一次单 Queue GPU submit 或 present。

core_principles: Preprocess only produces logical dependency and translation input.
Translate only records native payload and produces translate completion event.
Submit assembly only consumes translate results and constructs submission thread input.
Submission thread only resolves physical waits/signals and performs GPU submit/present.
Interrupt thread only handles post-submit host-side completion work.
Every queue keeps monotonically increasing contiguous signal values.
Cross-queue synchronization is represented by logical sync points first, then resolved to physical timeline values at submission time.

responsibility: Read CommandList array and present request.
Split CopyScope into logical segments only for dependency analysis and later translation input.
Build resource state snapshots, CopyScope handoff plans, Transition plans, and logical dependency edges.
Produce TranslateInfo objects, not SubmitInfo.
must_not_do: Must not assign physical fence handles or timeline values.
Must not decide queue signal values.
Must not directly build submission thread payload.
output: present metadata for trailing graphics submission candidate

responsibility: Each TranslateInfo becomes one TranslateTask.
TranslateTask records native command buffer / VulkanRecordedSubmit payload.
TranslateTask.Dispatch() returns GraphEventRef for async-ready shape.
Current implementation may execute synchronously, but interface remains task-based.
must_not_do: Must not resolve cross-queue wait timeline values.
Must not own submit-time dependency resolution.
Must not directly enqueue runtime completion tasks.

responsibility: Consume TranslateResult only.
Merge translated payloads into SubmitInfo according to single-queue submission semantics.
Attach trailing present stage to the last graphics SubmitInfo when required.
Create logical SyncPoint graph for submitinfo-level dependencies.
rules: SubmitInfo is the submission-thread unit of work.
SubmitInfo cannot be used as translate input.
Multiple translated segments on the same queue may be merged here if they belong to one queue submission unit.

responsibility: Consume SubmitInfo only.
Resolve SyncPoint waits into concrete WaitEvent values.
Assign per-queue contiguous signal values.
Perform queue submit and optional present.
Publish resolved SyncPoint to dependent submissions.
Wait for physical completion generated by submission runtime.
Recycle allocator / presentor.
Run callbacks.
Signal user-facing fences/events.
Trigger GraphEventRef completion events.
Handle frame-end tasks.

translate_result.purpose: Translate output and submit assembly input.
fields: callbacks/signals/runtime flags moved forward from source submit

rules: SubmitInfo cannot contain translate-only state such as tracker seed or raw segment planning.
SubmitInfo dependencies are expressed via SyncPointId instead of physical timeline values.

motivation: Current wait/signal derivation happens too early in preprocess.
Physical timeline value is unknown until submission thread decides actual queue submission order and signal allocation.
Cross-queue dependency should be expressed as logical dependency between SubmitInfo units.

definition.syncpoint: A logical completion point exported by one SubmitInfo and consumed by dependent SubmitInfo objects.
definition.granularity: SubmitInfo-level, not raw segment-level physical wait/signal.

rules: Every SubmitInfo exports one completion SyncPoint by default.
Cross-queue waits reference SyncPointId only before submission.
Submission thread resolves SyncPointId into concrete WaitEvent.
Resolved physical signal value comes from the producer queue's contiguous signal allocator.
If a SubmitInfo has no command buffer but is still observable by dependency/callback/signal semantics, it still gets a real queue signal via empty submit.

registry_model.name: SyncPointRegistry
responsibility: Register producer syncpoints.
Register producer -> consumer dependency edges.
Resolve syncpoint to {timeline_handle, value} once producer submit completes.
Notify dependent SubmitInfo objects that one logical wait is now physically resolvable.

submission_runtime_flow: Submission thread checks whether all logical sync waits of a SubmitInfo are resolved.
If not resolved, keep the SubmitInfo pending.
When a producer SubmitInfo is submitted, submission thread allocates the next contiguous signal value on that queue.
Submission thread resolves the producer completion SyncPoint with that physical fence/value.
Once all logical waits of a dependent SubmitInfo are resolved, it becomes ready for submission.

example.input: gfx(with CopyScope) -> split into gfx, copy, gfx
submit_infos: SI1(Copy) waits SP0 and exports SP1
SI2(Graphics) waits SP1 and exports SP2
runtime_resolution: Submit SI0 on Graphics queue, allocate GraphicsTimeline = N, resolve SP0 = {gfx_timeline, N}
SI1 becomes ready, waits {gfx_timeline, N}, submit on Copy queue, allocate CopyTimeline = M, resolve SP1 = {copy_timeline, M}
SI2 becomes ready, waits {copy_timeline, M}, submit on Graphics queue, allocate GraphicsTimeline = N + 1, resolve SP2 = {gfx_timeline, N + 1}

present_semantics.rule: Present is attached as an optional trailing stage of the last graphics SubmitInfo instead of being a standalone top-level platform op.
completion_model: SubmitInfo completion syncpoint represents queue-submit-visible GPU completion used for downstream GPU waits.
Present completion belongs to retire/completion handling and is consumed by interrupt thread for host-side recycle/callback work.
Present must not pollute cross-queue SyncPoint semantics.

translate_tasks.current: May dispatch synchronously and wait immediately.

submit_assembly_task.current: May run synchronously after translate completion.
submit_assembly_task.target: Can be dispatched as a task waiting on translate_complete events.

submission_thread.role: Owns physical submit order, SyncPoint resolution, queue signal allocation, and GPU submit/present.

recommended_file_split.responsibility: Submission thread + SyncPoint resolution + interrupt enqueue.
Present context and present completion handling.
Private shared types: TranslateInfo, TranslateResult, SubmitInfo, SyncPointRegistry.

initial_step: First rewrite checkpoint plan around TranslateInfo, TranslateResult, SubmitInfo, and SyncPoint.
Then move logic out of the current monolithic VulkanSubmissionExecutor.cpp by phase.
Keep current behavior synchronous first, but preserve async-ready task interfaces.
non_goals: Do not solve all performance tuning before architecture boundaries are corrected.
Do not keep adding new feature branches on top of the current monolithic PlatformExecOp path.
Do not let preprocess encode physical queue timeline values.
